title: Keyboard Manager - Shortcut Mapping does not take effect

status.label: Clarify the shortcut target and current behavior
status.detail: The report is unclear whether it concerns Keyboard Manager remapping or an Always on Top shortcut; another user says the issue also occurs on PowerToys 0.91.1.

judgment.rationale: The report lists PowerToys 0.73.0, identifies Always on Top as the area, and says enabling keyboard shortcut mapping has no effect; the screenshots may contain the exact setting, but the text does not specify the shortcut or target. Two commenters report the same symptom, including one on 0.91.1. The module and exact failing action remain ambiguous, and no linked fix was found.
evidence: The report lists PowerToys 0.73.0 and Windows, with text saying shortcut mapping was enabled but nothing happened.
The issue form's area field says Always on Top while its title and product label say Keyboard Manager.
The expected and actual behavior fields include screenshots rather than a textual shortcut or target.
Two commenters report the same problem; one explicitly lists PowerToys 0.91.1.
The issue remains open and unassigned; no linked fix was found.
judgment.recommended_action: Ask which module and exact shortcut/action are failing on a current stable version, using the existing screenshots as context.

fix_assessment.rationale: If a supported Keyboard Manager or Always on Top shortcut still fails, the shortcut may not be registered or applied. The report's module and configured keys must be identified before choosing a code path.

proposed_fixes.title: Make the reported supported shortcut take effect
proposed_fixes.root_cause: The configured shortcut may not be registered by the intended module, or the report may describe an Always on Top hotkey rather than a Keyboard Manager remap. The provided text does not distinguish these cases.
plan: Confirm the current PowerToys version, intended module, exact shortcut, and exact action expected.
Reproduce the mapping on current stable and check whether the module reports a conflict or unsupported shortcut.
If a supported shortcut is accepted but not applied, correct registration or dispatch in the identified module.
Add a focused test that verifies the selected shortcut invokes the intended action.
verification: Verify the exact shortcut invokes the intended Always on Top or remapped-key action.
Verify unsupported or conflicting shortcuts are reported clearly.
Verify unrelated shortcuts continue to work.

confidence.rationale: The symptom is corroborated by two commenters, but the module, configured shortcut, and current release behavior are not specified in text.

issue_context.summary: Shortcut mapping reportedly has no effect, but the issue does not clearly identify whether the target is Keyboard Manager or Always on Top.
known_information: The original report lists PowerToys 0.73.0 and says enabling shortcut mapping has no effect.
The form identifies Always on Top as the area, while the issue title and product label identify Keyboard Manager.
Two commenters report the same symptom; one uses PowerToys 0.91.1.
inferences: The issue may be a shortcut-registration bug, but the intended module and configured key/action are unknown.
issue_context.analysis: The current-version symptom appears corroborated but is not actionable for implementation until the target feature and exact mapping are identified. Avoid inferring details from screenshots without confirming them.
initial_investigation: Read the issue body and all comments, including the conflicting module information and the later 0.91.1 report.
No linked fix or exact covering issue was found.

information_gaps.information: Which module is being configured, the exact shortcut and intended action, and whether that setup still fails on current stable
information_gaps.why_needed: The module and shortcut determine which registration path to investigate; the old original version alone cannot establish current behavior.
information_gaps.how_to_collect: Reply with the current PowerToys version, module name, exact source shortcut, target action, and whether the same setup fails after restarting PowerToys.

actions.label: Confirm the module and shortcut behavior

comment.body: The report says the shortcut mapping has no effect, but the issue identifies Always on Top as the area while the title and label point to Keyboard Manager. Could you share the current PowerToys version, the module you configured, the exact shortcut and intended action, and whether the same setup still fails after restarting PowerToys?
